_comment: Dotwork settings for this web-3d game (tools/art/dotwork/config.example.json lists every key). A web game has no Godot: Dotwork writes PNGs, sheets, .fnt fonts and the asset manifest (engine none) into public/assets/, which Vite serves and the shell reads (prompt glyphs in public/assets/ui/glyphs/). The importer in src/game/dotwork/ (DotworkLibrary) loads public/assets/dotwork/*.assets.json.
